extracted.name: Roasted carrots
extracted.description: These sticky honey-roasted carrots make a simple yet scrumptious side for Christmas dinner or a Sunday lunch
ingredient_lines: 2 tbsp red wine or cider vinegar
instruction_lines: Heat the oven to 200C/180C fan/gas 6. Bring a large pan of water to the boil. Add the carrots, bring back up to the boil and cook for 5 mins.
Drain and leave in a colander to steam-dry for a few minutes, and then toss in a large roasting tin with the olive oil, honey, vinegar and seasoning. Roast for 30-40 mins.
